entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, just what the hell's happenin'[n]in her heart?
entries.uk: Слухайте, та що за чортівня[n]коїться в її серці?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's this bandit, those weird voices[n]sayin' "you killed her," and who knows[n]what else...
entries.uk: Цей бандит, ті дивні голоси, що кажуть[n]«ти її вбила», і ще казна-що...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba's supposed to be the queen of this[n]Palace, but even she can't control it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If I had to guess, I'd say her suppressed[n]memories are causing her to lose[n]command over it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Regardless, we should go back and open[n]the gate of fire.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, I said wait! We're—
You're too slow, moron. You'll never[n]catch me at this rate.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He ran off again! Hurry up and catch him,[n]fast!
Hahaha, you tired already? What a bunch[n]of losers... Grave-robbing is a game of[n]stamina, y'know?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Urghhh, he got away again! This is really[n]pissing me off!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll never catch him if we do nothing[n]but follow his path... We should corner[n]him somewhere.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Corner him? But how?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's use that square from earlier. We [n]sneak around him and trap him in there!
I'm tellin' you, it's no use! You guys[n]should just give up!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Grhhh! That freakin' bastard really[n]pisses me off!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Just carefully observe where he's headed![n]We should be able to corner him with a[n]bit of skill!
So stubborn... Haven't you had enough[n]already? You guys're never gonna catch[n]me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is humiliating, but we must endure.[n]Our only option is to corner him, correct?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. We should sneak around from the[n]other side and corner him in the square[n]where we first met.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There he goes...! We finally chased him[n]into the square!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perfect. He has nowhere else to run now...[n]Let's do this, Joker!
